children: VICTORIA, Seychelles, September 9, 2026

As Tesla stages one of its sharpest single day moves in months and Nvidia shakes off a volatile session from the day before, Zoomex, the global cryptocurrency derivatives exchange, is once again spotlighting its Stock Perpetuals offering as the venue for traders who want to react to swings like these without the friction of a traditional brokerage account. Built to be Easy to Use from the first click, Zoomex gives retail and professional traders alike a single, unified interface to trade names like TSLA and NVDA, backed by a platform that is Transparent by Design in how positions, margin, and funding are calculated and displayed.
Tesla: Cybercab Launch Fuels a Sharp Rally

Tesla shares have broken well clear of their recent trading pattern today. After spending the past several days confined to a relatively tight band between roughly $350 and $361, the stock jumped more than 6% on Thursday, September 3, climbing to around $378.75 as traders position ahead of the company's closely watched Cybercab event in Austin, where Tesla is expected to unveil the production version of its two-seat, steering-wheel-free autonomous vehicle.
Source: Zoomex

The move hasn't stayed confined to Tesla alone, Lucid rose roughly 3%, and Rivian ticked up more modestly, confirming that today's rally is driven specifically by the Cybercab catalyst rather than a broader sector move. Analysts remain split on what comes next, Morgan Stanley has kept a Hold rating and a $400 price target, warning the stock could "sell off through the event" if Thursday's presentation lacks concrete production timelines, while StoneX has reiterated a Buy rating with a $475 target tied directly to the Cybercab launch. Beyond the event itself, Tesla reported a rebound in August global deliveries even as Europe remained a soft spot, disclosed a China recall covering roughly three million vehicles over door-handle and driver-monitoring concerns, and pointed to new self-driving data showing a sharp reduction in collision rates versus manually driven cars. Against a 52-week range of $297.38 to $498.83 and a Wall Street consensus price target near $423, the stock remains a magnet for traders positioning around delivery data, regulatory headlines, and Elon Musk's broader autonomy roadmap.
Nvidia: A Volatile Session Ahead of Tesla's Big Day

Nvidia had its own turbulent ride heading into Tesla's headline event. Yesterday, Wednesday, September 2, shares swung through a wide range of roughly $216 to $228 before the session settled near $224, only modestly above where it started the day.
Source: Zoomex

That volatility follows Nvidia's recent fiscal second-quarter results, which showed revenue up 106% year over year to $96.2 billion and non-GAAP earnings climbing 120% to $2.22 per share, both ahead of analyst expectations. The market is also still digesting news of Nvidia's $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, a move read as a deepening bet on the AI software stack, along with an upcoming $0.25 cash dividend carrying a September 10 ex-date. Even with the stock still trading at a discount to the broader Nasdaq-100 on a price-to-earnings basis, analysts including New Street's Pierre Ferragu see a run past $400 as plausible within eighteen months, while hyperscaler capital spending, projected to climb from roughly $800 billion in 2026 to $1.3 trillion in 2027, continues to anchor the long-term demand story for Nvidia's data center chips.
Focused on Derivatives: Trading TSLA and NVDA Without Leaving Zoomex

This is precisely the kind of two-sided, headline-driven action that Zoomex Stock Perpetuals were built for. Rather than requiring a traditional equities account, settlement delays, or exposure limited to a single exchange's trading hours, Zoomex lets users open long or short perpetual contracts referencing TSLA and NVDA directly from their existing derivatives account. The product sits at the center of a platform that is Focused on Derivatives rather than trying to be everything at once, which means the order books, leverage tools, and risk controls traders already use for crypto perpetuals extend naturally to major U.S. equities without forcing anyone to learn a second system.
Fair Access & Rule-Based Execution at the Core of the Product

Fair Access & Rule-Based Execution sits at the core of how Zoomex has designed the Stock Perpetuals product. Every position is filled against clearly published rules rather than discretionary intervention, funding rates and mark-price mechanics are calculated on a fixed, disclosed schedule, and the same execution logic applies whether a trader is sizing into a Tesla position ahead of the Cybercab event or building an Nvidia position around a dividend date. That consistency matters most in exactly the kind of session TSLA and NVDA are having this week, when price can move sharply on a single headline and traders need confidence that the mechanics underneath their trade won't shift with the market.
A Growing Stock Perpetuals Lineup

Zoomex Stock Perpetuals currently span a growing list of household names alongside TSLA and NVDA, including UnitedHealth, General Electric, JPMorgan, and Gilead, giving traders a single account to express views across technology, healthcare, industrials, and financials without juggling multiple brokers. The addition of two of the most actively traded and news-sensitive stocks in the market, at a moment when Tesla is staging a major product event and Nvidia is still digesting an acquisition and a whipsaw trading session, reflects Zoomex's broader push to make institutional-grade market access available through a Fair Access & Rule-Based Execution framework that does not discriminate between a first-time trader and an experienced professional.
About Zoomex

Founded in 2021, Zoomex is a global cryptocurrency trading platform focused on derivatives trading. The platform serves over 3 million users across 35+ countries and regions, offering access to 700+ trading pairs. Built around easy to use, transparency, fairness, and speed, Zoomex provides a clear and efficient trading experience for users worldwide.

Through its high-performance matching engine, clear asset and order displays, and transparent fee and rule mechanisms, Zoomex helps users better understand their account status, order execution, trading costs, and results. Zoomex maintains registrations, licenses, and regulatory statuses across multiple jurisdictions, including the U.S. MSB, Canada MSB, U.S. NFA, and Australia AUSTRAC, and has completed security audits conducted by blockchain security firm Hacken. The platform also continues to strengthen its trust framework through Proof of Reserves, Security & Transparency, Compliance Information, and Fees / Rules Transparency initiatives.

Beyond trading, Zoomex builds a refined brand experience through elite sports partnerships, including the TGR Haas F1 Team, World Cup-winning goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez, and world-class tennis events such as Wimbledon. The values of speed, precision, discipline, fair play, and rule-based execution are closely aligned with Zoomex’s approach to derivatives trading.
